chip.description: Main-CPU/sound-CPU interface and audio control latch (MIRAC): four host-to-sound registers, two sound-to-host registers and a maskable interrupt line to the sound CPU.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/k056800.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Konami 056800 MIRAC" ("Sound interface and audio control"). Filed io per taxonomy Q11, as for the 054321.
